features: Anyone running their own copy gets the same assistant tools, with nothing extra to run alongside it.
improvements: Syncing a busy iCloud or Fastmail calendar is quicker, because Keeper.sh now asks only for the copies it made.
A repeating event that has already ended is no longer worked out again on every sync.
fixes: Events created with a time offset rather than a Z now land at the time you gave.
Reading a repeating series too large to expand now returns a clear explanation.
A paid plan no longer shows as free when the billing provider is slow.
The subscription button no longer flickers between two labels while your details reload.
Your published feed now covers the full range you set, and no longer drops events once it grows large.
Signed-in pages no longer fail, and scheduled syncing is no longer cut short, on a half-hourly cadence.
Events copied to Google keep their meeting details instead of being rewritten every sync.
Connecting an account works when it has no readable calendars, or one calendar has no name.
Descriptions copied to iCloud and other CalDAV calendars arrive as plain readable text, not full of markup.
Events on iCloud, Fastmail and other CalDAV calendars keep the right time across a daylight saving change.
Large CalDAV calendars, Zoho among them, import every event instead of stopping at a thousand.
Deleting an event removes it from iCloud and other CalDAV calendars instead of leaving it behind.
A slow server or a timeout no longer asks you to reconnect a working CalDAV account.
Events no longer go missing when Microsoft rate-limits your mailbox. Writes wait and retry.
An Outlook event with no title no longer stops the whole calendar from being read.
A properly connected Outlook account no longer asks to be reconnected.
Following a link from the bottom of a page opens the next page at the top.
One event with an unreadable timezone no longer stops a whole subscribed calendar.
The first import of a calendar you just added uses the range you configured.
An event with no duration arrives on the other calendar instead of being retried forever.
All-day events that came from a timed calendar are no longer deleted and recreated every sync.
